notes: Both cameras use the same original TrafficSignalDetector/profile. Each counts its own fresh distinct frames in a full trailing 2-second window. Either camera can confirm red or green at the shared red_confirm_percent (legacy key). Red wins red/green conflicts, yellow also holds. Votes reset when stationary waiting starts so pre-stop green cannot complete a run. Secondary remains ground-motion source. Start does not require lamp visibility. Green completion is speech only, with no forward output.
